identitySignals: Third-party business directory lists 'Cal Play Services, Inc.' as an active corporation with a Wildomar, CA principal address, matching the agenda location (secondary source only; the Secretary of State record was not directly viewable)

Name suggests playground work, consistent with an OUSD site improvements contract at Burbank Early Childhood Education, but no official site or public page confirms the company does this work or works with OUSD
research.notes: Only third-party aggregators (bizprofile.net, BBB listing for a Cal Play Services Inc. with a PO Box in Chino and phone (909) 519-0574, industry 'synthetic rubber') were found. No official website, no direct SOS or SAM.gov record could be fetched. Aggregator shows a Florida-state document number and an EIN, which look unreliable and were not used. Not confirmed as the OUSD vendor; do not publish.

profile.summary: Cal Play Services, Inc. is a corporation with a principal address in Wildomar, California. No official website was found, so its services could not be confirmed from the company itself.
